**Public beta — feedback is welcome.** Questions, bug reports and suggestions: **[repro4chful@gmail.com](mailto:repro4chful@gmail.com)** or [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/KyuuketsukiAkado/stardew-tracker/issues/new/choose).

Stardew Tracker is a local, offline progress tracker for Stardew Valley 1.5 / 1.6 saves. It reads a save on your computer to show collections, bundles, perfection and today's options; no mod, SMAPI or Python installation is needed for the packaged apps. It does not upload your save.

> This is an unsigned beta. The redesign is still in progress. The new interface was checked in a browser using a synthetic farm, **not on a physical phone**; the macOS and Linux binaries are exercised by automated smoke tests, not manually on those platforms.

## Download

| System | File | Inside |
|---|---|---|
| **Windows** | `StardewTracker-windows-v0.4.0-beta.3.zip` | `StardewTracker.exe` |
| macOS (Apple Silicon only) | `StardewTracker-macos-v0.4.0-beta.3.zip` | `StardewTracker` |
| Linux (x86-64) | `StardewTracker-linux-v0.4.0-beta.3.zip` | `StardewTracker` |

SHA-256 checksums are in `SHA256SUMS.txt` next to the archives.

## How to run

1. Unpack the archive and run `StardewTracker.exe` (macOS / Linux: `./StardewTracker`).
2. The app opens a local browser page at `http://127.0.0.1:8777` (or the next available port). **It asks before looking for saves** in the standard folders and lists those folders; choose Allow, enter another folder, or choose Not now. You can change this later under **Folders**.
3. Close the console window to stop the app. Your goals and notes remain on your device: `%APPDATA%\StardewTracker` (Windows), `~/Library/Application Support/StardewTracker` (macOS), or `~/.local/share/StardewTracker` (Linux).

The apps are **not code-signed**. Windows **SmartScreen** may require *More info* → *Run anyway*; on macOS right-click → *Open* or use `xattr -d com.apple.quarantine StardewTracker`. On Linux, run `chmod +x StardewTracker` if needed. Only run binaries you trust; verify their checksums first.

## What's new in beta 3

- **Bigger controls for collections and bundles.** ☆, ✎ and item information buttons have 40×40 px targets. In bundles, select an item to reveal its actions; Enter/Space opens it, Tab moves between actions, and Escape closes it and returns focus. Home/Today bundle links still lead to their rooms and bundles. Existing marks, notes and progress calculations keep their keys and meaning.
- **A calmer, more useful overview.** One action you can do today appears first; progress numbers and status colors are easier to read. The beta notice and metrics use less space on phones.
- **Phone sprite fix.** Fish, museum and shipping icons no longer show neighboring sprite cells at widths up to 450 px. A separate Chrome smoke test caught and fixed a bundle-grid overflow at 320 px on Linux.
- **Save discovery requires permission.** The tracker asks before scanning standard save folders and lets you use another folder or revoke consent.
- **Landing page and QA.** A bilingual GitHub Pages page offers OS-aware download links. Browser checks of RU/EN, light/dark, layout and keyboard behavior now run in CI on a fictional farm; the demo is rebuilt deterministically.

## Known limitations

- The redesign is ongoing; collection pages and other areas have not all been rebuilt. Some controls outside the item actions remain smaller than 40 px.
- Multiplayer: only the host is counted. Some details are absent in older 1.5.6 saves.
- The new touch-target layout was checked at 320/390/768/1440 px with a synthetic farm, but **not manually on a physical phone**. Windows, macOS and Linux release binaries receive automated CLI smoke tests. This beta's packaged apps have not been manually tested on all three systems.
- macOS binaries target Apple Silicon on a recent macOS; Intel Macs are not supported, and older systems may require running from source. Obelisk / Golden Clock names and the game's own perfection percentage have not been cross-checked against real saves.

This is an unofficial fan project. Stardew Valley, its game data and sprites are © ConcernedApe; the project is not affiliated with them.

## По-русски

**Публичная бета — нужна ваша обратная связь.** Вопросы, баги и предложения: **[repro4chful@gmail.com](mailto:repro4chful@gmail.com)** или [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/KyuuketsukiAkado/stardew-tracker/issues/new/choose).

Локальный офлайн-трекер Stardew Valley 1.5 / 1.6: для готовой сборки не нужны моды и Python. Сейвы никуда не отправляются. Распакуйте архив из таблицы и запустите приложение; **до поиска сейвов** оно покажет папки и спросит разрешение. Можно выбрать другую папку или пока отказаться; настройка доступна позже в разделе «Папки».

**Что нового:** в коллекциях и бандлах зоны нажатия ☆, ✎ и подсказок — 40×40 px; в бандлах действия раскрываются нажатием на предмет и доступны с клавиатуры (Enter/Space, Tab, Escape). Главная предлагает одно доступное дело на сегодня, а иконки предметов на телефонах больше не показывают соседний спрайт. Проверки RU/EN, тем, размеров и клавиатуры на вымышленной ферме теперь выполняются в CI.

**Ограничения:** бета не подписана, SmartScreen и Gatekeeper могут показать предупреждение; на физическом телефоне эту сборку вручную не проверяли. Windows/macOS/Linux сборки получают автоматический smoke-тест, но не все три платформы проверены вручную; macOS — только Apple Silicon. В мультиплеере считается лишь хост. Проверьте `SHA256SUMS.txt` перед запуском.
